lines.t: He spoke all into existence, everything according to his plan
From the gentle ant's persistence, to the mighty trees that stand
He formed man from the dust of the earth
He knew me before my birth
All creation He spoke into being
From every blade of grass to every mighty tree
Yahuwah caused it to be
He created it all, all that I see
He caused it to be
Mountains rose at His command
He made the firmament on which we stand
Everything crafted by His hand
Every living thing he spoke into being
From the birds of the air
To the fish deep in the sea
He caused it all to be
Every flower he caused to bloom
He brought forth life from the gloom
Every hill, every valley
The earth began to rally
From the beautiful plants
To the volcano that spews its
Fervent heat
He caused all to meet
All creation
He spoke into being from every blade of grass to every mighty tree
Yeah, who I caused it to be
He created it all, all that I see
He caused it to be
Mountains rose at His command
He made the firmament on which we stand
Everything crafted by His hand
Every living thing He's spoken to be
From the birds of the air
To the fish deep in the sea
He caused it all to be
In His image we are wonderfully made
A beautiful truth that will never fade
With purpose and breath
He fashioned our frame
From the stars above
To the oceans vast and deep
He caused it all to be
